task_definition.task_description: Please find me a recommended alternative in the same audio category for the black Sony XM5, then place an order for the best replacement option. After that, generate an invoice for one black Sony XM5 for $349.99 to alice@example.com via PayPal, check the current New York time, and then send me an instant message saying the recommended replacement order has been placed and the invoice is ready.

user_input.query: Please find me a recommended alternative in the same audio category for the black Sony XM5. The product_id is p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, and the items are [{ product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }]. Once you find the best replacement option, place the order for user_id alice. Then generate an invoice for one black Sony XM5, product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, for $349.99 using PayPal as both the payment_method and payment_gateway, and send it to alice@example.com. After that, check the current New York time in the America/New_York timezone, and send an instant message to alice at im_recipient alice with this exact confirmation_message: "Your recommended replacement order has been placed and the invoice is ready."
user_input.confirmation_message: Your recommended replacement order has been placed and the invoice is ready.
